question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
thresholds AS (
  SELECT 
    min_ms,
    max_ms,
    avg_ms,
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as short_to_medium,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as medium_to_long
  FROM stats
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= t2.short_to_medium THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= t2.medium_to_long THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN thresholds t2
)
SELECT 
  c.category,
  ROUND(MIN(c.Milliseconds / 60000.0), 4) as min_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(c.Milliseconds / 60000.0), 4) as max_minutes,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0), 2) as total_revenue
FROM classified c
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON c.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY c.category
ORDER BY 
  CASE c.category 
    WHEN 'Short' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Long' THEN 3 
  END
